settings.stateHint: Cooperative law differs by state. We use this for by-law and grievance questions.

notice.legalBody: Answers explain what public documents say and where to complain. They never predict the outcome of a dispute. Check the cited source or ask an official before acting.
notice.sidebar: Information, not legal advice. Always check the cited source.

ask.title: Ask Sahkar Saathi
ask.description: Ask about cooperative law, by-laws, crop insurance, schemes or grievances. Every answer shows its source.

grievance.title: Grievance redressal
grievance.description: Describe your problem. We suggest where to complain, the steps, the documents you need and a draft you can edit.

about.title: About & help
about.description: How Sahkar Saathi works, what it cannot do, which sources it uses and how your privacy is protected.

quality.title: Quality dashboard
quality.description: How well the assistant does on the 80-question test set: retrieval, faithfulness and refusals.

chat.welcomeBody: Type your question, or pick one below. Answers come from public cooperative documents and show their source, date and page.
chat.recordingAnnouncement: Recording. Tap Stop when you are finished.
chat.reviewTranscript: Check and edit your words before sending.
chat.lowConfidenceTranscript: Some words may be wrong. Please check the text.
chat.keyboardHint: Press Enter to send. Press Shift and Enter for a new line.
